title: Persist artifact point telemetry and add canvas/PIXI render-tree probe

phases.title: Add canvas/PIXI point-probe telemetry and include it in diagnostic snapshots
Persist picked artifact telemetry and expose canvas probe details in the Diagnostics UI and clipboard JSON

finalChecks.name: Persistent probe wiring present
finalChecks.run: grep -q 'diagnosticProbeStorageKey' scripts/scene-library.mjs && grep -q 'Canvas / PIXI point probe' templates/scene-library.hbs

finalChecks.name: Manifest version
finalChecks.run: node -e "const m=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('module.json','utf8')); if(m.version!=='0.3.10') throw new Error('expected module 0.3.10');"
